name: Anshika Yadav

lede: ECE undergrad at IIIT Jabalpur who's spent the last year shipping load-testing pipelines at Amazon and training vision models in Japan. I like clean systems, tiny details, and the occasional bit of sparkle.
about: Currently: wrapping up my B.Tech in Electronics & Communication at IIIT Jabalpur (2022–2026), while working across cloud infrastructure and applied AI.

At Amazon, I spent six months building automated load-testing pipelines for Appstore's purchase and subscription systems — the kind of infrastructure that has to hold up on Prime Day and NFL Game Day. At Seiko Electric in Japan, I trained a vision transformer to tell AI-generated images from human-made ones, on a dataset of 2.5 million images.
Outside of work, I'm usually deep in a Codeforces problem, or thinking about the next feature for a health-tech project aimed at frontline workers back home.
